question: Under one explicitly new development ROM and screening circuit, does reducing input storage alone improve reachable source-to-startup conditions without changed door motion, precharge or hidden energy? This prioritizes what should receive native replay; it cannot decide physical feasibility.
scope: Four bounded reciprocal screening trajectories in a separately versioned surrogate, after all model inputs and numerical budgets are pinned. Necessary energy/domain conditions are conditional on that model, not a global impossibility bound on the real device.

fixed_world.mechanical_q0: design-bound equilibrium from same force table, with initial mechanical energy explicitly counted

baseline.firmware: unchanged source-bound shared C; prototype phase-average loads remain assumptions

single_intervention.justification: Existing source-supported storage change, same nominal geometry and topology; no semantic recasting of supply or force.

gate_before_any_execution: Independent reviewer accepts this plan and the fully specified screening provider; parent authorizes execution.
Pin exact derived-ROM parameter file, derivation/source hashes, topology, rail/current laws and applicability. This plan does not fill undocumented PMIC dynamics.
If provider cannot make a defensible conditional necessary-condition inference, report source/storage sensitivity only; do not call it necessary-condition screening.
Freeze wall/RHS budgets, solver version/tools and output list; no retries or adaptive extra designs.
Reuse only source/geometry/angle/q-domain matching force samples. Existing quadrature consistency is not full magnetic qualification; sparse unrotated COMSOL mesh failed and must remain failed.

native.required: Exact upstream DoorBeam output rows/model/tool/source plus complete ROM extraction, not just four numerical constants.

independent_development_derivation.method: New Euler-Bernoulli composite-section stiffness and Rayleigh-Ritz first-mode mass/coupling derivation, independently checked by a second algebra/quadrature implementation. Explicit magnet mass, laminate neutral axis, electrodes and modal normalization.
assumptions: Declared copper dimensions/E/density and magnet geometry/density from source
PZT elastic/piezo/dielectric coefficients must be sourced and pinned from an actual material reference; absent coefficients are unknown
Damping remains an explicit sensitivity/assumption, not calibration
independent_development_derivation.limit: New reduced-order development provider only; not prior COMSOL reproduction, nonlinear calibration, or native/physical qualification.

forbidden: Old cloud ROM silently renamed native
cache-downstream-demonstration fixture rom.json (fixture checkpoint, inconsistent cached metadata)
Filling missing PZT constants or CAP/VIN2 dynamics from convenient arbitrary values

static_rail_knowledge.role: Pin/settled-energy and nominal state semantics only. PGOOD initial assertion needs converter sleep; 92% is falling threshold. No dynamic startup predictor.
cannot_supply: CAP/VIN2 charge currents and time constants
Transient source energy or mission witness

possible_pre_execution_work_without_new_: Hash/pin canonical force functions and source-bound coordinates
Derive and independently check a transparent development ROM from actual sourced constants
Compute separate required stored-energy arithmetic, keeping simultaneous states and load work separate so no double-counting
Build native evidence import checklist and zero-state ledger schema
outputs: source/load work and all modeled stores
initial equilibrium/preparation ledger with physical preparation unknown
domain exits and source hash manifest
no feasible-reference or physical mission pass flag

decision.fails_energy_or_domain: Do not broaden sweep; select the smallest evidenced model/mechanical extension for review. Failure is conditional, not physical impossibility.
decision.passes_screening: Prioritize exactly this baseline/intervention pair for independently qualified native PMIC replay; still no feasible reference.
decision.model_missing_or_undocumented: Stop dynamic screening at the preflight boundary; continue independent parameter/source derivation only.

facts_user_may_eventually_need_to_supply: Actual installation envelope/placement and allowable actuation force for product requirements
Actual intended weak-motion duty and event/action definition when claiming that behavior
Actual preparation/reset usage when making battery-free first-operation physical claims
autonomous_explicit_development_assumpti: Use inherited component nominal values only as tagged source assumptions
Use a transparent independently derived ROM under declared small-deflection limits
Freeze exploratory provider and numerical checks without promoting them to user requirements
native_reference_blockers: Verified native ROM and full-domain force/nonlinear applicability
Exact licensed macro port declaration/wiring, rail currents/potentials and initial states
Independent complete firmware and attributed receiver evidence
